def _fwd_context_impl(probs: Tensor,
    v: Tensor) -> Tensor:
  sk = torch.size(v, 0)
  b = torch.size(v, 1)
  np_ = torch.size(v, 2)
  hn = torch.size(v, 3)
  bnp = torch.mul(b, np_)
  sq = torch.size(probs, 1)
  v3 = torch.reshape(v, [sk, bnp, hn])
  vt = torch.transpose(v3, 0, 1)
  context = torch.bmm(probs, vt)
  _0 = torch.permute(torch.view(context, [b, np_, sq, hn]), [2, 0, 1, 3])
  out = torch.view(torch.contiguous(_0), [sq, b, torch.mul(np_, hn)])
  return out

def _bwd_context_impl(grad_out: Tensor,
    probs: Tensor,
    v: Tensor) -> Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
  sk = torch.size(v, 0)
  b = torch.size(v, 1)
  np_ = torch.size(v, 2)
  hn = torch.size(v, 3)
  bnp = torch.mul(b, np_)
  sq = torch.size(probs, 1)
  v3 = torch.reshape(v, [sk, bnp, hn])
  vt = torch.transpose(v3, 0, 1)
  _0 = torch.reshape(grad_out, [sq, b, np_, hn])
  _1 = torch.reshape(torch.permute(_0, [1, 2, 0, 3]), [bnp, sq, hn])
  grad_context = torch.contiguous(_1)
  grad_probs = torch.bmm(grad_context, torch.transpose(vt, 1, 2))
  grad_vt = torch.bmm(torch.transpose(probs, 1, 2), grad_context)
  grad_v = torch.reshape(torch.transpose(grad_vt, 0, 1), [sk, b, np_, hn])
  return (grad_probs, grad_v)

def _bwd_scores_impl(grad_scores: Tensor,
    q: Tensor,
    k: Tensor,
    scale: float) -> Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:

  b = torch.size(q, 1)
  np_ = torch.size(q, 2)
  hn = torch.size(q, 3)

  qt = torch.transpose(q3, 0, 1)
  k3 = torch.reshape(k, [sk, bnp, hn])
  kt = torch.transpose(torch.transpose(k3, 0, 1), 1, 2)
  _0 = torch.bmm(grad_scores, torch.transpose(kt, 1, 2))
  grad_qt = torch.mul(_0, scale)

  grad_k = torch.reshape(_2, [sk, b, np_, hn])
  return (grad_q, grad_k)
